style: Vertical 2:3 premium hand-painted anime-adventure portrait, accurate Naruto character appearance based on official reference where available. One human character, face in upper half, color-coordinated canonical skill or village background, calmer lower 20% for UI name. New pose/composition, never a copied frame. No words, logos, gore, horror, dismemberment or grotesque anatomy.

colorLogic.white: lightning, Byakugan, ice, paper, luminous Hidden Cloud
colorLogic.blue: water, Hidden Mist, Rain Village, blue flame or sky
colorLogic.red: fire, Uchiha, Sand Village red sandstone and sunset
colorLogic.black: shadow, earth, Sound Village, Akatsuki night scenes
